scripts.web: apiPort=$(bun ../../scripts/ports.ts server) && metroPort=$(bun ../../scripts/ports.ts mobile) && EXPO_PUBLIC_ALLIANCE_API_PORT=$apiPort BROWSER=none expo start --web --port $metroPort
